sourceInformation.source: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim (Bethesda Game Studios, 2011)
sourceInformation.genre: Open-world action RPG with stealth and theft
sourceInformation.perspective: Third person (default) and first person, switchable; shared and split-screen chase cameras for local play
sourceInformation.tech: my-3D2dge 0.101.0 (2D and 3D engines, patched); three.js 0.182.0 (WebGPURenderer, WebGL 2 fallback); Rapier 0.19.3 (rapier3d-simd-compat); Web Audio API; 52in1 session client 1.4.0; one HTML file; bun for bundling; Playwright 1.63.0 for tests
sourceInformation.artDirection: my-3D2dge native 3D: a low-resolution pixel picture, procedural terrain and structure textures, pixel-art characters on cards, low-poly pen-drawn dragons and creatures; a cold northern palette with firelight and aurora
sourceInformation.animation: Procedural: engine Humanoid rigs with E.MOVES and new poses, procedural creature and dragon skeletons with IK feet, first-person arms on the overlay pen, scripted set pieces with timers
sourceInformation.audio: All Web Audio code: synthesized instruments for music at 10% default volume, synthesized sound effects, syllable-driven gibberish voices
sourceInformation.online: 52in1 sessions: parallel, ghost, shared-world co-op and versus (session protocol 1, client 1.4.0)
sourceInformation.testing: Headless Chromium through Playwright 1.63.0 (WebGL 2 on SwiftShader); Node unit tests; a scripted full playthrough with an autopilot; the 52in1 session harness in every online mode; the catalogue checker; emulated pads and phone profiles; OfflineAudioContext checks; screenshots and filmstrips at 1920x1080 looked at by eye
sourceInformation.research: The plan's research (the my-3D2dge 0.101.0 handoff, the 52in1 session, catalogue and languages pages, a single-file packaging test), plus reading the engine source and API for every system used

testingFeedback: Most helpful: The scripted playthrough. The autopilot plays every quest with real inputs, and it found most content bugs: missing stage triggers, interiors built twice, bad spawn rules.
Least helpful: Full-size screenshots under software rendering. They are slow and show little that the state checks do not show.
engineFeedback: Liked most: One file gives a 3D world, physics, rigs, a pen for procedural models, input with pads and a pause menu. No asset files are necessary.
Would change: A documented way to keep several worlds (a terrain world and many interiors, each with physics) and switch between them. Much glue code did this.
promptFeedback: Confusing: The plan fixes the model, the tool and the environment in advance. The game was built in another environment, so those values do not match the run.
Would change: Let the builder fill the model and environment fields from the real run, and keep the scope smaller so each feature gets more polish.

aiHub.name: Slyrim
aiHub.description: Explore a cold northern valley in first or third person. Fight, sneak, steal and shout to kill the dragons that came back.
aiHub.controls: WASD to move; mouse to look; click to attack; right click to block; E to use; Z to shout; C to sneak; Tab for menu; arrows for player 2; gamepad to play
